# Supabase browser client

Pinned `@supabase/supabase-js` 2.57.4, the version already used by Herald's account system.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4/dist/umd/supabase.min.js

Served with Herald so sign-in does not depend on a separate CDN script loading. Passwords are sent to Supabase Auth; they are never saved as application data.
